findings.title: Output URL check assumes an unverified alpha background
findings.consequence: The foreground-only default has bBackgroundValid=0; final override validity is unresolved. All thirteen URL ratios pass on the ignored-background branch, but fail (1.5613–3.1857:1) if a valid override uses opaque RGB. The current ARGB blend is not established by either inspected branch.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Inspect final URL format properties and validity after theme/default merging; register the proven underlay/rendering behavior before proposing a color change. Conditional RGB failures are not confirmed runtime defects.

findings.title: Active selection omitted from broad syntax checks
findings.consequence: 59 of 273 syntax/active-fill pairs fail 4.5 across eleven themes; the broad matrix omits active selection while the selected-foreground test does not model normal selection painting.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Add all registered syntax families to the active-selection matrix, separate High Contrast, and review the failing theme values and overlapping highlights.

findings.title: Contrast helper rounding changes pass/fail
findings.consequence: FE989898 over FF303228 is 4.4916975 with fractional blending but 4.5144298 in the older helper. Separate threshold tolerances also differ.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Consolidate consumer-aware contrast math; retain exact intermediate channels for modeled blends and apply strict thresholds. Keep output formatting separate.

findings.title: Status strokes are classified as normal text
findings.consequence: Four SystemFill status tokens receive 4.5 normal-text checks although the reference describes stroke/border uses. This can drive unnecessary recoloring and does not validate message text.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Identify status glyph/stroke and message-text consumers separately, then validate each against its actual adjacent surface.

findings.title: Card ladder provenance conflicts with current reference
findings.consequence: The guide claims installed Dark control/card tiers together; configured card alpha tiers are 0F/15/08 while the current reference uses 0D/08/12. A palette difference alone is not a defect.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Relabel the retained card ladder as project policy unless a version-pinned installed reference supports the claim; handle any visual change as a later review.

findings.title: Confirmed-contract enforcement exceeds retained evidence
findings.consequence: Of 53 confirmed entries, this audit supports four, identifies nine mismatches and leaves forty uncorroborated. Together with the existing sixteen, 56 remain unresolved in this audit. Production registry labels are unchanged.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Require per-consumer rendering provenance and underlay/state evidence in step 2; distinguish named-pair screening from confirmation.

findings.title: Generic raw pairs still imply text semantics
findings.consequence: The broad fallback calls every other unclassified raw pair normal text. Existing marker and diagnostic consumers demonstrate that component names alone are insufficient.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Replace inferred enforcement with explicit reviewed classifications; retain unknown pairs as advisory screening until traced.

findings.title: Amberroot overlay checks contradict unresolved consumer status
findings.consequence: Six statement/code-analysis checks enforce alpha-blended normal text without a verified consumer. CodeAnalysisKeyEventSelection is simultaneously unresolved in F06-063. No actual outline/text rendering is claimed here.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Trace statement and analysis formats individually, including native/RGB resolution, before retaining a text test or baking colors.

findings.title: Notification checks do not match the inspected current template
findings.consequence: Eight F02 title/subtitle state contracts do not describe the inspected UserNotificationsWindow item template, which uses ToolWindowText and a different normal parent surface.
findings.recommendedCorrection: Register the inspected template and its state chains; investigate alternate consumers before altering or removing the legacy pairs.

interpretation: Nine underlying findings. The 64 mismatch-assessed rule sites in rules.json share these findings; they are not 64 independent defects. Unresolved records are investigation work, not proven runtime failures.
